svg.title: Four checkout recovery candidates
svg.desc: Four equally weighted conceptual choices: zonal deployment in one region; warm standby in another region; active-active serving in two regions; or pilot light with only essentials running in the secondary. None guarantees recovery or ranks costs without workload requirements.
